question: Point \(P\) lies outside line \(l\), and \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\) are three points on \(l\). Given \(PA=5\) cm, \(PB=3\) cm, and \(PC=4\) cm, the distance from point \(P\) to line \(l\) is
solution: The perpendicular segment is the shortest. The distance from point \(P\) to \(l\) does not exceed the length of any connecting segment, so it is no greater than \(PB=3\) cm (but is not necessarily equal to \(3\) cm).
